title: Return Policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original condition. Start a return from your order history or contact support with your order number.

title: Shipping Times
content: Standard shipping takes 5–7 business days. Express shipping delivers in 2–3 business days. Free standard shipping is available on orders over $50.

title: Refund Processing
content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after we receive and inspect your return.

title: Product Warranty
content: Electronics include a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended protection plans can be purchased at checkout for an additional 2 years of coverage.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Buy Now, Pay Later options are available through Klarna and Affirm.

title: ShopAssist Plus Membership
content: ShopAssist Plus members get free express shipping, early access to sales, and 5% back on every purchase. Membership is $9.99/month or $89/year.

title: Current Promotions
content: Use code WELCOME15 for 15% off your first order. Members receive an additional 10% off during seasonal sales. Promotions cannot be combined unless stated.
